reason: The local executor became unavailable after all three independent audits had completed. This recovery record describes publication packaging only.

methods.static_and_receipt: Deterministic report objects restored from the already recorded audit output and compared with SHA256 values logged before the environment failure.
methods.payload: Original scientific archives were read and their byte/hash bindings recomputed to restore the exact previous audit JSON.
methods.format: Machine receipts were restored from cached original remote reads and native process results; the human-readable README was restored from its previously written text.
